locations.title: Stacking Button Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the starting field near the cliff

**Solution:** Stack up your friend to reach the button on the crane

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Timing Button Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of a hill over the valley

**Solution:** Click every button on the green structure at the same time

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Matching Tiles Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** At the top of the hill over the valley

**Solution:** Match the tiles on the pegboard outside with what can be seen inside the room

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Locked Box Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the cliff looking over the valley

**Solution:** Have one person sit and press the button, opening the box across the valley, while another heads to the box 
- [Locked Box](#loc=930216)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Maze Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Down the mountain on the beach

**Solution:** Grab the timer and hand off the timer through the holes to your friends to place it on the pedestal

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Point and Click Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On the side of a mountain

**Solution:** Press the buttons in the correct sequence copying the lights from the inside without being able to communicate

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Cannon Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On the rocks next to the [Train Station](#loc=930175)

**Solution:** Activate the timer to shoot it out of the cannon, then have a friend grab it and throw it back and place it into the pedestal

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Basketball Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Next to the stream in the open

**Solution:** Throw the light through the hoop until the bar fills up

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Memory Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On a ledge of a cliff

**Solution:** Open up only the orbs that have the green blobs in them to activate the pillar

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Pose Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the cliff looking over the valley

**Solution:** Have a friend head to each of the points with the red ledges and match the poses on the cards, then place the cards with the correct pose into each of the slots
- [Pose Picture](#loc=930217)
- [Pose Picture](#loc=930218)
- [Pose Picture](#loc=930219)
- [Pose Picture](#loc=930220)
- [Pose Picture](#loc=930221)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Counting Lights Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Near the train tracks in the open

**Solution:** Count how many of the lights change after clicking the button for the period of time they change, then input that amount into the counter on the wall

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Locked Up Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the brush

**Solution:** Press both buttons on the walls to unlock the red blob, then hit the secret button and give the correct order for the symbols on the wall to escape

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Far Away Lights Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On the beach in two separate buildings 
- [Far Away Lights Puzzle Second Building](#loc=930215)

**Solution:** Have at least one friend in each building and count the lights on the wall. Relay that information to the other building to increment the counter.

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Double Press Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On a ledge up the mountain

**Solution:** Press the switch the same time as a friend pushes the switch on the rocks near the beach
 - [Second Switch](#loc=930223)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Clifftop Golf Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On the edge of the cliff

**Solution:** Carry the ball from the starting point and place it into the hole
- [Golf Tee](#loc=930296)

**Reward:** Purple Blob

locations.title: Warehouse Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On a ledge between the water and the middle of the mountains

**Solution:** Head through both doors, close them, and head through the turnstiles, then communicate the order of the icons from one player to the other

**Reward:** Purple Blob

locations.title: Beach House Icon Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On a ledge over the shore

**Solution:** Head through both turnstiles, then communicate the order of the icons from one player to the other on the back porch

**Reward:** Purple Blob

locations.title: Greenhouse Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On a ledge between the beach and the middle of the mountains

**Solution:** Have a friend go into the side room and communicate which sounds match the speaker in the sound room and slot them into the right hole

**Reward:** Purple Blob

locations.title: Beach Timer Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of some scaffolding over the water on the beach

**Solution:** Using your friends, carry one over the different obstacles to open the doors, requiring clicking switches at the same time and maneuvering over a large staircase, to bring the timer to the pedestal at the end

**Reward:** Purple Blob

locations.title: Multi-Light Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Split between two buildings on a ledge over the water
- [Multi-Light Puzzle Second Building](#loc=930259)

**Solution:** Head into both buildings and, using the intercom and the red light, communicate which lights to click in sequence

**Reward:** Purple Blob

locations.title: Patience Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the cliff overlooking the water

**Solution:** Sit there for 30 minutes with a friend and enjoy their company :)

**Reward:** Purple Blob

locations.title: Ravine Golf Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** At the bottom of the cliff at the end of the ravine

**Solution:** Carry the ball from the starting point and place it into the hole
- [Golf Tee](#loc=930296)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Passing Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of a ledge up the cliff

**Solution:** Have a friend head across to the opposite side and communicate which pieces need to be passed across to fill in the symbols

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Interrogation Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** In the side of the cliff

**Solution:** Using the one-way glass and the red light, relay the information between players on which symbols need to go to which spot

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Climbing Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the cliff embedded into the ground

**Solution:** Start at the bottom and keep kicking the block with the blob in it up onto the platforms. Slowly but surely keep doing it until it reaches the top, then place it on the pedestal

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Stage Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Embedded in the cliff wall

**Solution:** Have a friend head into the upper stage area and communicate which buttons need to be clicked by which ones are lit up

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: 50/50 Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** In a building raised over the forest

**Solution:** Using the red light and the speaker, communicate between each other the rest of the symbols to complete both sides

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Headless Chicken Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On the side of the hill near the coast

**Solution:** Have a friend put on the mask and head into the area through the turnstile, then navigate your blind friend to match the symbols in pairs

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Tower Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On the beach next to the water

**Solution:** Hit both of the nearby switches at the same time
- [Tower Switch](#loc=930326)
- [Tower Switch](#loc=930327)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Forget-Me-Not Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of a peninsula embedded into the ground

**Solution:** Head to previous puzzles with the corresponding icons and sounds and place the icon/sound on the corresponding slot

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Brown Tower Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the forest

**Solution:** Have a friend head to and push the hidden button to open the box
- [Brown Tower Button](#loc=930343)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Invisible Ink Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the forest on a hill

**Solution:** Using the telescope, look at each blank sign to read their symbols. Memorize their symbols then head out of the room and close the door to figure out the order to place them

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Hanging Timer Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of some scaffolding off the side of the cliff

**Solution:** Using your friends, carry one over the different obstacles to open the doors, requiring clicking switches at the same time and maneuvering over a large staircase, to bring the timer past the last door to the pedestal at the end

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Camouflage Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Embedded in the rocks on the beach

**Solution:** Hold the button down on the green obstacle down the beach to open the box
- [Camouflage Box Button](#loc=930333)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Little Patience Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of a ledge over the water

**Solution:** Sit there for 5 minutes with a friend and enjoy their company :)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Super Camouflage Box Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Hidden on top of the large rock near the stream

**Solution:** Hit this switch at the same time as a friend hits the switch down the stream
- [Super Camouflage Box Switch](#loc=930341)

**Reward:** Red Bolb

locations.title: Mountain Icon Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the mountain overlooking the cliff

**Solution:** Head through both turnstiles, then communicate the order of the icons from one player to the other on the back porch

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Mask Maze Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of some scaffolding hanging over the stream

**Solution:** Have a friend put on the mask and guide them through the obstacle course without them falling off to the button at the end

**Reward:** Red Bulb

locations.title: Large Warehouse Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Between two parts of a stream in the open

**Solution:** Head into both sides of the warehouse and communicate the order of the symbols using different poses

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Playground Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Embedded in the ground 

**Solution:** Head into each section of the puzzle and set up the kettles to be in the places where it would communicate to the other person where the dots should be, then allow the other person to head in then set up the symbols on the wall correctly

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Double Cliff Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the cliff over the train tracks

**Solution:** Head into each of the different buildings and communicate over the valley which lights need to be pressed
- [Double Cliff Puzzle Second Building](#loc=930356)

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Musical Speaker Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** In the open on top of a hill

**Solution:** Have a friend go into the side room and communicate which sounds match the speaker in the sound room and slot them into the right hole

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Hide and Seek Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the cliff overlooking the valley

**Solution:** Look around the area and find all 9 yellow dots, 9 red dots, 9 green dots, and 9 blue dots, corresponding to different parts of the scenery, then place them all on the board

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Musical Chair Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On a ledge overlooking the valley

**Solution:** Have someone sit in the chair and speak into each microphone. The correct microphone will hear clearly for the person in the chair, while the other ones will be one-sided

**Reward:** Red Blob

locations.title: Musical Camouflage Box Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Surrounded by large rocks near the speaker area

**Solution:** Have a friend head to the listening station over the water and have them listen to the song and press the button to open the box
- [Musical Camouflage Box Button](#loc=930337)

**Reward:** Red Blob
